findings.title: handoff_FXJA.json violates zcode_orch_v3_handoff@1 sha law
findings.detail: dispatch_sha=f9e7b400dfec5c064494a16c7bec0494b08545caa4a95b4e84736174d999ca7a is 64-hex (not a 40-hex git SHA) and != actual_start_sha=ffed828f73fa19fa0ff4aee3ac1b441909a43940, with no explanatory field. Schema law: 'both 40-hex; must be EQUAL or the handoff is INVALID'. Corroborated stale-draft pattern: CALCOST completion pass found its own draft with the same f9e7b400 value and non-conforming task_id/role and replaced it; FXJA's committed handoff (task_id 'FXJA', role 'LANE-FXJA (...)') shows the same pattern and was never replaced. FXJA evidence itself intact: 9/9 outputs re-hash MATCH at ac5c4c18, arithmetic reproduces.
